DUCK PARADE - a RetroStone VC game for Windows
(c) 2026 Pierre-Louis Boyer (8BCraft). Code MIT, art/music/sound CC BY-NC-SA 4.0: see LICENSE-duckparade.txt.

Mother Duck has lost her ducklings all over town. Hop across roads, rapids,
railways, park paths and lily ponds, pick up the lost ducklings on the grass
and lead them in a line behind you, hop for hop. Bring the parade into a nest
pond to bank it: a long line is worth a lot (n x n points), but every duckling
can be knocked off by the traffic. Don't dawdle: a hungry fox follows the
parade. Egg medals at 50, 100, 200 and 300 points, and your best is kept.

Run DuckParade.exe. No installation needed (SDL2 is built in).

Controls (SNES gamepad layout)
  A: start from the title.
  Arrows: hop in that direction. A also hops forward.
  After game over, A returns to the title; press A again to start.
  Start or Select during play: pause/resume.
  Pads 2-4: A or Start to join on the title, B to leave.

Keyboard: X = A, Z = B, arrows = D-pad, Enter = Start,
Backspace or Esc = Select. Other players use gamepads.

Up to four parents guide their parades together. Results show individual and family scores.

F11 or Alt+Enter: fullscreen. F12: screenshot. Close the window to quit.
Options: DuckParade.exe --scale 4 --fullscreen
The best score is saved in duckparade.srm next to the exe.
